definitions.explanation: The combined process of an aircraft departing from and arriving at the ground. A suru-verb that can also describe the act of taking off and landing.

examples.japanese: {離着陸|りちゃくりく}の{時間|じかん}。
{強風|きょうふう}のため{離着陸|りちゃくりく}が{遅|おく}れている。
examples.english: Takeoffs and landings are delayed due to strong winds.

examples.japanese: この{空港|くうこう}では{一日|いちにち}に{約|やく}{三百回|さんびゃっかい}の{離着陸|りちゃくりく}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: About 300 takeoffs and landings take place at this airport every day.

notes:
A compound abbreviation combining {離陸|りりく} (takeoff) and {着陸|ちゃくりく} (landing) into a single word. The {離|り} from {離陸|りりく} is placed before {着陸|ちゃくりく}.

USAGE:
Common in aviation, airport announcements, news reports, and discussions about air travel. Can function as a suru-verb: {離着陸|りちゃくりく}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}{回数|かいすう} — number of takeoffs and landings
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}が{遅|おく}れる — takeoffs and landings are delayed
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}{禁止|きんし} — takeoff and landing prohibited
- {垂直|すいちょく}{離着陸|りちゃくりく} — vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL)

RELATED TERMS:
- {離陸|りりく} — takeoff (only)
- {着陸|ちゃくりく} — landing (only)
- {発着|はっちゃく} — departure and arrival; broader term used for trains, ships, and planes
